limitations: Chromium viewport/touch emulation does not verify physical iOS Safari or Android Chrome.
Automated axe findings do not establish full accessibility conformance or screen-reader usability.
Page loads retain normal CSP; debugger-injected axe is an out-of-band local instrument and does not prove that CSP blocks every malicious script.
Read-only control probes do not establish stateful gameplay, account, private-data, email or payment correctness.
The local checkout SHA and health identity are recorded separately; a caller-provided deployment SHA is not independently verified by this runner.
physicalDeviceChecklist: iOS Safari on an actual iPhone SE: keyboard, scrolling, dialogs and tap targets.
Actual iPhone 14 and Pro Max: safe areas, rotation, text zoom and sharing.
Actual Android Pixel Chrome: soft keyboard, back navigation, clipboard/share and touch.

rawArchive.copyPolicy: Durable compact summaries, gzip/hash manifest, fresh fixture/guest reports, and focused diagnostics copied to primary. Original raw and full route/screenshot evidence retained in temp; raw exceeds 100MB and must not be staged.

statusExplanation: Raw report remains FAIL where detected. --no-lighthouse makes performance an explicit deferred phase; no critical axe failures does not imply zero serious/moderate findings.
controlsLimitations: Controls are enumerated when rendered in initial state, with each eligible non-anchor action probed once in a fresh read-only context.
Anchors are bounded HTTP HEAD checks; HTTP success does not verify intended destination semantics.
Each select uses one alternative option and each text input one Jordan value; every spelling, option, nested dialog, room state, and later revealed control is not exhausted.

Persistent writes are blocked except telemetry and read-only Loop configuration. Authenticated journeys, SMTP, two-account privacy, saved-row lifecycle, metrics arrival, and production quota behavior need separate evidence.
Owner-only themeLab is explicitly PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED, preserving HTTP/geometry/axe observations while skipping private control probes.
Normal CSP is retained; axe debugger evaluation is an out-of-band instrument, not a bypass of production page script restrictions.
Chromium mobile emulation is not physical Safari/Android device evidence.
